_meta.title: Slovakia: municipalities with Roma settlements (Atlas of Roma Communities 2019)
_meta.what_it_measures: Every municipality the 2019 Atlas lists as having Roma communities: total population, the Roma share of residents (as a range), the number of settlements and how many people live in settlements outside, on the edge of, or inside the village, plus water, sewage, power, gas, waste, environmental hazards, social services and distance to doctors, bus, train and shops. Field names are the Atlas column headings in Slovak.
